note_en: The notebook text is verbatim: 600 mL split into three 200 mL flasks, "Add 2.192 g of NaCl into the flask labelled [150mM NaCl]" and 3.652 g for 250 mM. Arithmetically 2.192 g is 150 mM in 250 mL, not in 200 mL (150 mM in 200 mL needs 1.7532 g, which is exactly what the Agar Application of Protectant table gives), and 3.652 g is 250 mM in 250 mL; the 7 July remake masses of 0.548 and 0.913 g per 50 mL are the same numbers divided by four. note_en: 20 July is a real set 5 trial 2 date, but it is the transfer date, not a measurement date: the July ELN logs "20260720 Transfer Arabidopsis to salinity plates - Purpose: Start experiment set 5 using seeds from 0719" (8 dots, 8 seedlings, done by Audrey H and Abby K). The sheet name therefore looks like the run's start date. No chlorophyll extraction is logged on or after 20 July in either notebook until 5 Aug (set 6); the only July extractions are 2 July (set 4) and 13 July (set 5 trial 1), so the trial 2 reading day is not in the notes at all.
note_zh: 7/20 是第 5 組試驗 2 的真實日期，但是移植日而非量測日：七月實驗紀錄有「20260720 Transfer Arabidopsis to salinity plates—Start experiment set 5 using seeds from 0719」（8 點、8 株，Audrey H、Abby K）。所以表名應是起始日。兩本紀錄在 7/20 之後直到 8/5（第 6 組）都沒有葉綠素萎取；七月只有 7/2（第 4 組）與 7/13（第 5 組試驗 1），試驗 2 的讀數日根本不在紀錄裡。

note_en: Every notebook value quoted in this item is verbatim in the 12 July entry (control 0.0154 / 0.0111 / 0.014; 1 mM 0.0095 / 0.0014 / 0.0087; 5 mM 0.0101 / 0.1050 / 0.0112; 10 mM 0.0114 / 0.0134 / 0.0024; 150 mM 0.0090 / 0.0013 / 0.0024; and so on), so only the spreadsheet side still needs checking. note_zh: 本項引的每一個紀錄數值都與 7/12 條目完全相符（control 0.0154/0.0111/0.014；1 mM 0.0095/0.0014/0.0087；5 mM 0.0101/0.1050/0.0112；10 mM 0.0114/0.0134/0.0024；150 mM 0.0090/0.0013/0.0024 等），所以只剩表格那一邊要核。兩點值得看：5 mM 第二管 0.1050 g 比前後管（0.0101、0.0112）大十倍，像是 0.0105 的小數點誤寫；250 mM NaCl 單組只有一管 7 株（「250mM NaCl (contains 7 plants) 0.0013g」）而非三管，與 7/13 盤位圖 B9、C9 空白相符。

note_en: The electronic lab notes cannot corroborate any of these five runs: the last agar Arabidopsis entry anywhere in the notes is 21 Aug (fresh weight of the heat stress pretest, and sowing 13 plates of 0.6% agar). The September Electronic Lab Notes contain no Arabidopsis, agar plate, chlorophyll or fresh weight work at all (the plant notebook's September entries are hay infusion and soybean hydrolysis), and there is no October plant entry. So set #9 ACCD, the ACCD heat trial, set #10 BoPEP4 and the 11 Sep buffer run exist only as decks and spreadsheets, with no notebook record of who ran them or when.
note_zh: 實驗紀錄無法佐証這五個实验：紀錄中最後一筆琉脂擬南芥工作是 8/21（熱逆境前測鮮重、播 13 盤 0.6% 琉脂）。九月實驗紀錄完全沒有擬南芥、琉脂盤、葉綠素或鮮重條目（植物紀錄九月只有草汁與黃豆水解），十月也沒有植物條目。所以第 9 組 ACCD、ACCD 熱逆境、第 10 組 BoPEP4 與 9/11 buffer 实验只存在於簡報與表格，沒有人員與日期的紀錄。
